visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a cluttered hobbyist studio. A man (Mr. Joe) wearing a black cap and a black hoodie with 'EVANGELION' text sits at a desk. Behind him, shelves are densely packed with action figures, paint bottles, and various tools. A hand enters the frame holding a smartphone, displaying a vertical video of another creator. (2) The focus shifts to the smartphone screen, showing a pair of hands on a green cutting mat assembling a blue dragon model (Kaido). Blue plastic tokens are shown and then 'transformed' into a completed model through a jump cut. (3) Returning to the studio, Mr. Joe looks surprised and then points confidently at the phone screen. He stands up and walks towards a blue wall featuring large Mazinger Z and other robot figures, selecting a specific character model. (4) A fast-paced montage follows, showing materials being tossed onto a surface: a plastic figure, white foam boards, a tube of UHU glue, a marker, and several paint bottles. Each item is labeled with large yellow on-screen text. (5) A woman with glasses and long hair in a ponytail appears against a split red and blue background. She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her finger. (6) Footage of a Japanese modeler, Nishi, working on intricate dioramas is shown. He uses a utility knife to carve blue foam and applies paint to large-scale sculptures, including a giant Titan head and a detailed pirate ship. (7) Mr. Joe returns, speaking with high energy and gesturing towards the camera. The video concludes with a close-up of his face in a wide-eyed, shocked expression while more modeling clips are briefly shown.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a friendly, conversational exchange between a male and a female voice. A light acoustic guitar track provides a soft musical bed. The male voice is relaxed and relatively low in pitch. (2) A secondary audio layer is heard as a phone video plays, characterized by slightly compressed quality. The man reacts with a sharp rise in pitch and excitement. (3) A series of loud, percussive 'thud' and 'impact' sound effects mark the start of a new phase. These SFX are synchronized with rapid visual transitions. The music shifts to a high-tempo electronic pop track with a heavy kick drum and bright synth melodies. (4) A female speaker takes over with a professional, broadcast-clear narration style. Her speech rate is moderate and highly articulated. Digital 'ding' and 'click' UI sound effects are frequently used to emphasize promotional text. (5) The male speaker returns with high vocal arousal and dominance, speaking quickly and ending with a dramatic, high-pitched exclamation. The BGM swells in volume before a final percussive 'hit' sound concludes the sequence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Explanation -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a high-energy promotional piece designed to market an online model-making course by Japanese artist Nishi. It uses the popular creator Mr. Joe as a 'hook' to express amazement at Nishi's skills before transitioning into a professional explanation of the course benefits and a discount offer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of an online course, a discount coupon offer ($300), and a call to action to fill out a questionnaire.
